page.notes: Six lines of Arabic verse, centred, could not be read letter by letter at this scan resolution; the counts given are approximate. The Latin italic passage is the printed translation of the Arabic troparion. "Often-" in the first paragraph is doubtful at the line end (possibly "Oft-"); reading kept as the scan shows it.
